notes: Webpack's `require.context(directory, useSubdirectories, regExp)`: the directory is enumerated at build time, `keys()` lists the matching requests (with extension-less and `index` alternatives) sorted, calling the context loads the module, and an unknown request throws `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. Static-only because Vite serves the fixtures at runtime; asserted in webpack-require-context.test.ts.
